subject.title: fix(elevenlabs): reject malformed base URL overrides

question: Should existing malformed ElevenLabs `baseUrl` overrides intentionally become a fail-fast configuration error, with an explicit supported recovery path, rather than retaining permissive or fallback behavior?
rationale: The implementation is technically coherent, but this alters the runtime outcome for persisted operator configuration and cannot be resolved from tests alone.

options.title: Require explicit recovery
options.body: Keep fail-fast validation, but add or document a supported Doctor/config recovery path for operators whose existing override is now invalid.

options.title: Accept fail-fast as-is
options.body: Approve the immediate actionable error as the complete upgrade behavior and rely on operators to correct or remove invalid overrides manually.

options.title: Preserve fallback behavior
options.body: Retain a compatibility fallback for invalid explicit overrides, accepting the risk of silently retargeting operator intent.

recommendation.title: Require explicit recovery
recommendation.body: Keep fail-fast validation, but add or document a supported Doctor/config recovery path for operators whose existing override is now invalid.

likelyOwner.reason: The assignee authored the commits that set the final validation and realtime compatibility behavior.
